{{Quote|You are hereby requested and required to proceed by fastest available means to the Telaris system and assume command of the Alliance fleet.|Mon Mothma, in a communique to Admiral Gial Ackbar|<ref name="RAS2">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>}}
The '''Telaris system''' was located in the [[Pakuuni sector/Legends|Pakuuni sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point between [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Dates">[[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma's]] communique to [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]], as presented in [[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]], dates to the [[Time/Legends|time]] period in which [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] was in use by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], which corresponds to between [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], [[Commander-in-Chief/Legends|Commander-in-Chief]] of the [[Alliance Military/Legends|military]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], sent a communique to Alliance [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] that contained orders for him to travel as fast as possible to the Telaris [[Star system/Legends|system]] and assume [[Commander/Legends|command]] of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]].<ref name="RAS2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Telaris system was first mentioned in [[Paul Murphy]]'s [[1990]] ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'', which was published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="RAS">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square T-6.<ref name="TEA" />
